counter_hypotheses.claim: ANIMO soil nitrification moisture response supplies H3 once a dry response factor is chosen.
counter_hypotheses.test: Check process-domain preconditions. The continuation owner is not qualified as soil-solution or microbially accessible soil NH4. Choosing a moisture factor, daughter owner or rate coefficient would add unqualified state mapping and parameters.

counter_hypotheses.claim: External literature should be used now to force a positive model-evolution choice.
counter_hypotheses.test: Ask whether a literature relation can be mapped without first inventing continuation-state phase/speciation, interface geometry, activation variables or a receiver. It cannot. Literature remains potentially useful after those semantics are independently established; its non-use here is not evidence that any candidate mechanism is physically absent.

counter_hypotheses.claim: A negative qualification plus operational state persistence is just H0 under another name.

The package explicitly leaves the physical rate null and denies inertness, so no physical zero-rate law is asserted.
